title: Driftwood Place | KEY.co
description_expanded: Tucked within the quiet elegance of Magnolia Cottages by the Sea, Driftwood Place offers a seamless blend of coastal charm and modern sophistication. Recently refreshed with thoughtful renovations, this three-bedroom, three-bathroom cottage features an expansive open-concept layout and a stunning new master suite complete with a private sitting area, workspace, and morning kitchen—ideal for slow, sunny starts to the day. A large screened porch beckons for morning coffee or starlit conversations, while the deeded beach access and heated community pool are just a short stroll away. Every corner of Driftwood Place is designed for comfort and convenience, whether it's the serene bathrooms with spa-like finishes, the two complimentary bikes for cruising along 30A, or the curated beach essentials like chairs, toys, and a wagon. The cottage serves as the perfect launching point for adventure, with the Timpoochee Trail steps away and local shops and eateries within easy reach. Combining tranquil surroundings with family-friendly amenities, this home is a timeless retreat that invites relaxation and connection on Florida’s most beloved coast.
